text: Share of other users' comments (OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments, parsed) that directly quote wording from the OP's title or argument (reference text, current supplied text including marked edits). A comment counts if it reproduces verbatim or near-verbatim OP wording, typically in quotation marks or block quote; endorsement or refutation not required. Not counted: quotes of other sources, paraphrases, topic mentions, or quotes matching only OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or outcome-reporting text (generic platform/delta-rule discussion remains eligible). Output is quoting comments divided by total comments, in [0,1]; 0 if none quote. Null if OC_comments is an empty list, malformed or missing; also null if OP title and argument are both missing, unless a match was positively established. List order is irrelevant.
